pipeline: img2blend v1 (silentfuture.img2blend), methodology adapted from img2threejs (Apache-2.0)

references.source: Photo by Luc Coekaerts from Tessenderlo, Flickr, https://www.flickr.com/photos/92947007@N03/26676317625 (crops of the valve region; found via Openverse, licence cc0 1.0)
Photo by Luc Coekaerts from Tessenderlo, Flickr, https://www.flickr.com/photos/92947007@N03/26676317625 (crops of the valve region; found via Openverse, licence cc0 1.0)

stated_dimension: handwheel diameter = 0.20 m (typical DN80-DN100 rising-main gate valve; pipe read as DN100)
limits: side, back and three-quarter views uncovered - body depth inferred from gate-valve type knowledge (oval bonnet, flat across the gate plane); rear assumed mirror of front
all dimensions estimated from the stated handwheel diameter; total height ~1.0 m derived from pixel ratios
materials inferred from sunlit photo pixels - rust and bitumen read, not measured; wall shadows ignored
the photo's slight pipe lean is read as camera perspective and idealized to vertical

gates.changed: first blockout: full mass stack built (pipe, flange, body, bonnet flange, bonnet, gland, stem, wheel plate) at stated scale; contract enforced green
gates.still_off: vertical proportions wrong vs front reference: photo shows valve head (pipe flange to wheel top) at ~33 percent of total height, build spends 42 percent on it - pipe too short, head stretched; wheel plate floats too high above the gland
gates.why: silhouette-defining proportion error is exactly what blockout must get right; geometry constants are wrong in the script, the plan (part list, stated dimension) is sound

gates.changed: Z constants recut to the photo's ratios: pipe 0 to 0.665, head compressed to top third (body 0.695-0.800, bonnet to 0.885, gland to 0.945, wheel hub 0.985); wheel dropped onto the gland
gates.still_off: wheel is a plate, bonnet a straight cone, no bolts/spokes/rings yet - structure and form work by design; nothing proportion-level remains off
gates.why: blockout criteria are mass placement and silhouette proportion in all views, and those now read against the front reference; uncovered views are self-consistent (rotational stack)

gates.changed: wheel is now rim + 5 spokes + hub + stem nut (joined as valve_handwheel about its hinge origin); gland is a 5-ring stack; pipe flange carries its 8 studs
gates.still_off: everything is straight-edged: body is a cylinder not a bulge, bonnet a cone not a dome, rim square in section - form pass work; no missing or floating part remains
gates.why: structure criteria are part presence, placement and articulation origins: both contract objects exist, every reference-visible sub-part is built and seated, the wheel spins about its own hub by construction

gates.changed: curved profiles landed: bulged body revolve, domed bonnet, chamfered bonnet flange, round-section wheel rim, smooth shading on body and wheel
gates.still_off: mass distribution is inverted vs the reference: the render's dominant rounded mass is a bulbous BODY below a small flange, but the detail reference shows a short drum body, then the widest element (a DOUBLE-disc bonnet flange), then the dominant dome as the BONNET above it, narrowing into the gland
gates.why: the shapes exist but sit on the wrong masses - a form error in the script's profiles, not a plan error; three-quarter view makes the onion silhouette obvious

gates.changed: mass order corrected: short waisted drum body, double-disc bonnet flange as the widest element (shadow gap between discs), dominant bonnet dome shouldering into the gland; round-sectioned rim kept
gates.still_off: flange studs are subtler than the photo's rust-swollen bolts; photo spokes arch slightly upward to the hub, mine are straight - recorded as accepted approximation
gates.why: form criteria: the three-quarter render now reads as a gate-valve head with correct curvature and edge character, not a toy; remaining deltas are surface-level, not shape-level

gates.changed: flat blockout colours replaced: pipe = patchy bitumen with rust break-through and sparse wrap-grey remnants; head and wheel share a rust recipe (patch noise, cavity darkening, edge rub-through, roughness 0.5-0.8, near-dielectric) with the wheel one register brighter
gates.still_off: photo reads warmer because it is lit by direct evening sun - the review light is neutral by design; close-range mottle still flatter than the reference, surface-pass work
gates.why: material criteria are slot assignment, palette and PBR class per part: all three slots carry the right class (matte rust dielectric, darker tar with sheen) and the palette sits in the reference's register

gates.changed: rust concentration biased towards the flange end of the pipe (height-weighted band mask), broad weather stains added to the head recipe, mottle contrast raised
gates.still_off: the photo's flaky micro-relief cannot be reproduced: pipeline v1 bakes basecolor/roughness/metallic only, no normal/height channel - stated as a pipeline limit, not fixable in this pass; wrap-vs-rust contrast slightly softer than the photo
gates.why: surface criteria are the wear register at prop viewing distance, and the banded, mottled, rubbed-edge story now matches the reference in all covered views; the remaining delta needs a bump channel the pipeline does not have
